title: Close the injection in the support tool's order search

blocks.text: The support tool lists a customer's orders: the agent types the customer's e-mail address, may pick a status, and can sort the result page by clicking a column header, which puts `?sort=total` or similar into the URL. A penetration test got every customer's orders back by typing a quote and a condition into the e-mail box, and another one appended its own SQL to the `sort` parameter.

`OrderSearch.search(...)` builds a `Query`: the SQL text, which the caller passes to `Connection.prepareStatement`, and the values the caller binds to it, in order. The text block and the assembly around it are done. Finish the two `TODO`s in `src/main/java/practice/OrderSearch.java`:

items: `condition(column, value, params)`: the condition for one column and the value the agent typed;
`orderBy(sortColumn)`: the column to sort by, `placed_at` when the URL has none. The page offers the columns in `SORTABLE`; anything else is refused with `IllegalArgumentException`.

blocks.text: When you're done, nothing an agent types or puts in the URL can change what the statement does. About six lines in total. The tests read the `Query` you return; no database runs.

cases.says: a search by e-mail address uses that address and sorts by the column the page asked for
a status adds a second condition, and with no sort column the orders come by placed_at
the statement text is the same whatever the agent types, quotes included, and the typed values are bound in order
a sort column the page doesn't offer is refused with IllegalArgumentException instead of reaching the SQL

origin.section: A Value Formatted Into SQL Becomes SQL; a Bind Parameter Stays a Value

concepts: A value formatted into a SQL text block becomes part of the statement, quotes around %s included; with a ? placeholder the statement text stays constant and the value is bound separately.
A table or column name can't be a bind parameter, so a user-chosen identifier is taken from a fixed set of names and anything else is refused.
